clue.text: Left part of part of 1 down in tree

parts.note: a bridge is part of the capital's crossing in 1 down, and an arch is one part of a bridge

explanation.surface: A clue pointing to the left-hand section of something growing in a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1 down answer is the old London crossing; an ARCH is one of its parts, and that part is itself 'part of' the answer's second word.
explanation.definitionFit: A deciduous conifer with needles that drop each autumn, so a kind of tree.

clue.text: Capital game, one removed to Arizona

explanation.surface: A capital-city game in which one player is sent off to Arizona.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1830s Thames crossing was sold in 1968, dismantled and rebuilt at Lake Havasu City, Arizona, which is what the definition alludes to.
explanation.definitionFit: The old Thames crossing was bought by an American developer and re-erected in Arizona, so it is the structure shipped there.

clue.text: Spooner's boxing and running in singularly incorrect 24

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the first letters of the two words are exchanged

parts.note: boxing is a fight
running is a race

explanation.surface: Someone muddles boxing and running in a wrongly worded drill command.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 is MARCHING ORDERS; this is a single drill order, and 'incorrect' plays on right meaning correct while also hinting that this command is given at the halt, not on the march.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill command to turn ninety degrees clockwise, one order rather than several, given to soldiers on parade.

clue.text: Why non-western article is in Kent

parts.note: the definite article

explanation.surface: Someone asks why a western article appears in Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is an English county in the south-east; HYTHE is a coastal town there, one of the Cinque Ports.
explanation.definitionFit: A seaside town on the south coast of the county, so a place located within it.

clue.text: Treat a number going in to go between

explanation.definitionFit: To dose or administer drugs to a patient is to give medical treatment.

clue.text: Over 501

clue.text: Dante's compatriot has taken to eating something like horse

clue.text: Dusk seeming dark is close to a disease for Jenny who sang at the Cape

TB, tuberculosis

explanation.definitionFit: The condition makes it hard to see in low light, so twilight seems gloomy to a sufferer.

clue.text: Bad habit, live at last light if I were you?

last light comes with the sun going down, a setting sun

parts.note: last light comes with the sun going down, a setting sun

explanation.surface: Advice to someone with a bad habit, telling them how to live at dusk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'if I were you' is taken literally: put I in the place of U (you).
explanation.definitionFit: A persistent fault that keeps tempting a person is a regular vice, which is a bad habit.

clue.text: Spreading the word makes most of you more than semi-disloyal

clue.text: 24 changes due to single state, as the saying goes

indicators.note: changes says the three letters of due are rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: 24 is MARCHING ORDERS, so BEAT IT. 'as the saying goes' points to the Beatitudes, the sayings of the Sermon on the Mount; one of them is a single state of blessedness.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of supreme blessedness, and also one of the Sermon on the Mount's blessings, each a saying.
